verdict.rationale: Docs mention generic export/HTTP APIs (event export, dashboard REST API) that could feed downstream systems, but there is no first-party documentation of dedicated destination integrations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks). A hands-on community report explicitly states Amplitude 'don't do a good job in sending data back to things like SFDC,' directly contradicting the notion of reliable onward streaming to third-party destinations. Missing for 10: dedicated 'Destinations' catalog docs, webhook configuration docs, and evidence of successful CRM/ad-platform sync.
